contact.name: Yevgen Kazakov
contact.evidence_quote: Yevgen Kazakov, EU Experiment Leader, highlighted the close integration of the European and Japanese teams: “It is very rewarding to see European and Japanese colleagues working together as one team. This workshop provided an excellent opportunity to exchange expertise in both directions, from QST’s Human-Machine Interface and analysis tools to EUROfusion’s analysis software and Pulse Design Simulator. This two-way exchange of knowledge is essential for the success of the next JT-60SA experiment

contacts.rung: Other role. Yevgen Kazakov is identified as the EU Experiment Leader.

external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Along with EUROfusion, the European fusion efforts are channelled to ITER through Fusion for Energy. While EUROfusion organises the European fusion research, Fusion for Energy oversees the industrial contributions to ITER. EUROfusion and Fusion for Energy work closely together in the Broader Approach; a collaboration with Japan which comprises amongst others the construction and exploitation of the superconducting tokamak JT-60SA.
